name: Ableton Live
note: Every row of chapter 41, "Live Keyboard Shortcuts", of the Ableton Live 12 reference manual. The context is Ableton's own section name within that chapter (41.1 Showing and Hiding Views, 41.2 Keyboard Focus and Navigation, and so on) and the action name is the manual's own label for the row. Where one row lists two keys for a paired command ("right and left arrow keys", "Page Up/Down keys", "+ -", "X and Z keys") or a range ("F1 - F8", "1 - 7"), the row is split into one action per key and the key is appended to the name in parentheses; the manual does not say which half of a paired label goes with which key, so the parenthesis names the key rather than claiming a direction. Where the manual prints two alternatives ("Shift Tab or F12", "Ctrl Alt B or Ctrl Alt 5", "Delete or double-click") only the first is kept. Ableton writes "Shift ?" for Hide/Show Info View; that is the Shift+/ key on a US layout and is written here as Shift+/. Left out because the grammar cannot express them: every mouse row (clicks, drags, Shift+scroll), every row whose shortcut is a bare modifier held while dragging, "Type In Value" and "Set Note Selection Velocity" (typing digits, not a chord), "Resize Clip When Insert Marker is at Clip Edge" (hold Enter and press an arrow), and the prose sections 41.25-41.29 (momentary latching, which only re-states shortcuts already listed above; Windows Alt+first-letter menu access; and the macOS Cmd+? menu search).
